Name: NPC Helper 2
Author: TamKungZ
Description:
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/54754/54754-1793594402-858074260.gif[/img]

[size=6][b]NPC Helper 2[/b][/size]
[i]Meet new custom characters in Stardew Valley, or make one of your own.[/i]

NPC Helper lets character mods add their NPCs to your game. Install NPC Helper and the character mod, then meet them in town just like other villagers.

[size=5][b]What can you do?[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Add custom villagers with their own dialogue, daily routines, portraits and sprites[/*]
[*]Get to know them, discover what gifts they like, and see how their stories unfold[/*]
[*]Date and marry characters whose mods include that content[/*]
[*]Watch heart events and hear festival lines from characters whose mods include them[/*]
[*]Play with NPC mods that include translations and changing outfits or portraits[/*]
[*]Create your own NPC with simple text files; no programming required[/*]
[/list]
[size=5][b]What you need[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6[/*]
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI 4.0 or later[/url][/*]
[*]NPC Helper 2, plus any NPC mods you want to play with[/*]
[/list]
[size=5][b]How to install[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI and launch the game through it at least once.[/*]
[*]Unzip NPC Helper into your game's [b]Mods[/b] folder.[/*]
[*]Install each NPC mod you want to use the same way (a mod manager such as Vortex or Stardrop works too). Keep each mod in its own folder in [b]Mods[/b].[/*]
[*]Translations are separate packs for the NPC they translate. Install them the same way; NPC Helper uses the one that matches your game language.[/*]
[*]Start the game through SMAPI. Check the SMAPI log if a character does not appear.[/*]
[/list]
NPC Helper is the tool that lets these characters join your game; it does not add a new character by itself. Install a character mod too.

[size=5][b]Want to make a character?[/b][/size]
You can create an NPC using text files—no coding needed. Make a content pack (a folder with a [b]manifest.json[/b] and an [b]NPCs[/b] folder), or start in [b]Mods/NpcHelper/NPCs[/b], and add a file named after your character, such as [b]Mira/Mira.toml[/b]. Add dialogue, a schedule, heart events, festival lines and artwork when you're ready. See the [url=https://dev.tamkungz.me/documentation/npchelper2]NPC Helper guide[/url] for examples and more details.


[size=5][b]Need help?[/b][/size]
If a character is missing or something looks wrong, upload your [url=https://smapi.io/log]full SMAPI log[/url] and include the versions of NPC Helper and the NPC mod.

[size=5][b]Author[/b][/size]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/TamKungZ]TamKungZ_[/url]
